mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of all trading days, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL > 285) signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 285), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
